name: v5_short_interest_quality
hypothesis: High short interest may indicate crowded negative positioning; paired with operating quality it may capture resilient firms under short pressure.
notes: Uses US News short-interest matrix; intended to diversify from analyst yield and buyback.

name: v5_customer_return_signal
hypothesis: Customer return signal may proxy supply-chain demand information and be less correlated with accounting-quality factors.
notes: Relationship dataset candidate; no quality anchor to reduce correlation.

name: v5_customer_authority_quality
hypothesis: Customer network authority may identify firms exposed to stronger customer ecosystems; combine lightly with quality.
notes: Relationship graph field with moderate coverage; watch sub-universe and correlation.

name: v5_news_index_underreaction
hypothesis: Post-news relative performance versus SPY may capture event underreaction after smoothing.
notes: US News matrix field; pure event-relative return channel.
